placements.title: Mandatory first-week checklist standardizes new hire onboarding across tooling, pairing, and shadow shifts
placements.frame: How is new hire first-week onboarding structured, sequenced, and maintained against legacy documentation?
placements.why: Both expressions establish the operational mandate and core components of new hire first-week onboarding via the Pallasine checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) and record its adoption timeline replacing the legacy wiki documentation.
